roadmap.title: Step 1 — Story, Chapters 1–2 (roughly the first 30 hours of a 60–80 hour story)
roadmap.body: Play the story and enjoy it. The one thing that can lock is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and accept. While you play, scan each new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study new animals through binoculars as you meet them — the 100% checklist later wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; there are 15 slots and missions cannot be replayed.

roadmap.title: Step 2 — Story, Chapters 3–5 and the finale
roadmap.body: Finish the story. The chapter and mission trophies pop as each chapter closes, and the final mission pops the gold You Gotta Know When to Get Off. Play the stranger strands as they appear — Andy is Lucia-only, Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only. Save before the final mission.

roadmap.title: Step 3 — Side stories, activities and robberies
roadmap.body: Clear the 8 stranger strands, the 42 shooting-range golds, the 14 drone-race locations, 20 different race wins, the 5 bank vaults and one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs). Robberies feed the Marked Bills for Dime on the Dollar and the cash for the 8 garages.

roadmap.title: Step 4 — Cleanup: collectibles and the 100% checklist
roadmap.body: Sweep up the collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas, garages, Scooter Bros registrations) and finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road. The checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — those last groups need everything, so leave nothing half-done. Cheats disable trophies, so keep them off for the whole run.

disputes: Grade split: one guide (Push Square, via GTAViceCityHub) lists 5 silver / 47 bronze, while PowerPyx and Insider Gaming list 6 silver / 46 bronze. This guide follows PowerPyx and PSNProfiles: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.

Hidden flags: PSNProfiles lists 28 of the 55 as hidden. The 28 flagged here are the story, side-story-finale and cryptic-description trophies; the 27 visible ones are the ones PSN shows from the start. The total matches PSNProfiles; individual flags are our reconstruction, since PSNProfiles itself would not load for us to check each one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole road 4/10 and about 200 hours, with A Long Road (100% completion) as the hardest single trophy. [3][4]

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically. [3][4]
Plan on one playthrough of roughly 200 hours — no second run is needed, since nothing is missable except possibly the first meditation. [3]
Keep cheats off the entire run: cheats disable trophies. [3][4]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is unmissable — finish it and the trophy pops. It is the first story beat of Chapter 1 and sets up Jason and Lucia. [3][4]

steps.text: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. [3][4]
No side objective is needed; completing the mission is enough. [1][9]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter closes, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only thing in the game that can lock, and this chapter is your only window for it. [3][4][12]

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 1 missions through to the chapter's end. [3][4]
The morning after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude. [3][5][12]
Make a manual save at the end of the chapter; missions cannot be replayed. [3][4]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 2 missions. [3][4]
The trophy pops when the chapter ends; no extra objective is required. [1][3]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 3 missions. [3]
Scan new vehicles and study new animals along the way for the later 100% work. [3][8]

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 4 missions. [3][4]
The trophy pops when the chapter ends. [1][3]

steps.text: Make a manual save before the final mission. [3]
Complete the final mission to close the story. [3][12]

steps.text: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then complete it. [3][4]
No extra objective is needed beyond finishing the mission. [1][3]

steps.text: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then complete it. [3][6]

steps.text: Play the story until Child's Play appears, then complete it. [3][4]

trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Play the story until Headliners appears, then complete it. [3][4]
Finishing the mission is enough. [1][3]

steps.text: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears, then complete it. [3][6]
Finishing the mission is enough. [1][3]

trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears, then complete it. [3][4]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx: reach 100% on the in-game checklist. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals — but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need every single one, so leave none of those half-done. [3][4]

steps.text: Open the 100% checklist in-game and work through it after the story. [3][4]
Complete 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals. [3][7]
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — those groups need 100% of their items. [3]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy — every stunt you land now is one you will not have to hunt later. [3][4]

steps.text: Find stunts on the map and complete any 250 of the 397. [3][4]
There are 4 stunt categories, including 130 stunt jumps — mix them as you like. [3][6]
Push on to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist once this trophy pops. [3][11]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, and the rest of Leonida's pastimes. One try each is enough — no wins required. [3][4]

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once — racing, fishing, ranges, drone races, arcade, bowling and the others. [3][4]
Use the in-game activity list to see which types you have not tried yet. [3][6]
No win or score is needed; a single attempt at each type counts. [3]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges. This is one of the groups the 100% checklist needs in full, so every gold here does double duty. [3][4]

steps.text: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and work through their challenges. [3][4]
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges. [3][6]
Replay a challenge as often as needed — ranges stay open after the story. [3][11]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total across them). Like the ranges, drone races are needed in full for 100%, so a win at every spot counts twice. [3][4]

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone-race locations across Leonida. [1][3]
Win a race at each of the 14 locations. [3][4]
Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win — retries are free. [3][6]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so repeats of the same race do not count. Leonida's race events are spread across the map, on road and off. [3][4]

steps.text: Enter race events across Leonida and win 20 different ones. [3][4]
A repeat win on a race you already won does not add to the count. [1][3]
Pick the fastest vehicle you own for each race type. [3][6]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, and this is its one head-to-head trophy — find Cal, take the challenge, and out-fish him. [3][4]

steps.text: Find Cal and accept his fishing challenge. [3][4]
Out-fish Cal in the challenge to take the trophy. [3][6]
If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win. [1][3]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Arcades are scattered around Leonida — walk up to a cabinet, play it through, and the trophy pops when you finish. [3][4]

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida. [3][4]
Play and complete any one arcade game. [3][6]
A high score is not needed — finishing the game is enough. [1][3]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — his final mission. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia when they appear. [3][4]

steps.text: Play Andy's missions as Lucia as they appear. [3][4]
Complete his final mission to close the strand. [3][6]
Strand missions stay available after the story, so there is no rush. [1][3]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand — his final mission. Play his missions as they appear and close the strand with its last job. [3][4]

steps.text: Play Kenton's missions as they appear. [3][4]
Complete his final mission to close the strand. [3]
Strand missions stay available after the story. [1][3]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand — his final mission. Play his missions as they appear and close the strand with its last job. [3][6]

steps.text: Play Billy's missions as they appear. [3][6]
Complete his final mission to close the strand. [3]
Strand missions stay available after the story. [1][3]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus the rest. Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only, so swap characters to clear them all. [3][4]

steps.text: Find and start all 8 stranger strands across the map. [3][4]
Play Andy's strand as Lucia; Tyrone's and Bret's as Jason. [3][6]
Finish each strand's final mission — the trophy pops on the eighth. [3]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand — his final mission. Play his missions as they appear and close the strand with its last job. [3][6]

steps.text: Play Randy's missions as they appear. [3][6]
Complete his final mission to close the strand. [3]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand — his final mission. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, so play them as Jason when they appear. [3][4]

steps.text: Play Tyrone's missions as Jason as they appear. [3][4]
Complete his final mission to close the strand. [3][6]
Strand missions stay available after the story. [1][3]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 meditations across 10 locations — most spots count once per character, so Jason and Lucia each meditate at the same place. THE MISSABLE ONE: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony at Jason's house and choose Accept. That session is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Dispute — sources differ: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say the first meditation can lock the trophy, while other guides note only 15 of 18 meditations are needed for 100% and the spot is not marked. Our call: do the balcony session in Chapter 1 anyway; it costs a minute and removes the only risk in the game. [3][4][5][12][13]

steps.text: DO THIS FIRST: the morning after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. [3][5][12]
Meditate at all 18 spots across the 10 locations; most spots count once per character, so both Jason and Lucia meditate at each. [3][5][4]
The other spots stay open for the whole game — only the Chapter 1 balcony session can lock. [3][13]
Dispute note: whether the balcony session is strictly required is unconfirmed — only 15 of 18 are needed for 100% and it is not a marked spot — but doing it in Chapter 1 removes all doubt. [4][13]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only — his quests are also one of the groups the 100% checklist needs in full, so every Bret hunt counts twice. [3][4]

steps.text: Play Bret's strand as Jason as his missions appear. [3][4]
Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. [3]
Finish all of Bret's quests — the 100% checklist needs every one. [3]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — 15 sets exist for 100%, so the 3 sets for this trophy are only the start of the card hunt. [3][4]

steps.text: Collect cards around Leonida and complete any 3 sets. [3][4]
Cards are found in the world and through activities — check the collection screen to see which sets are close. [3][6]
Keep going to all 15 sets for the 100% checklist. [3]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK app to scan and tag 100 spots around Leonida. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two hunts overlap nicely. [3][4]

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app and WAiNK It at locations as you travel. [3][4]
Reach 100 WAiNKed locations. [3][8]
Scan new vehicles with the same app along the way for Whip It Good. [3]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and the 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number — keep the challenge list open as you play. [3][4]

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. [3][4]
Pick the easy ones first — many complete themselves during normal play. [3][6]
Push on to 70 challenges for the 100% checklist. [3]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it with the partner character present — solo escapes do not count. [3][4]

steps.text: Play with your partner present and raise your wanted level to 4 stars. [3][4]
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. [3][6]
Escape with your partner still with you — the trophy pops on the getaway. [1][3]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the heat drops. Plan a route of three close shops and keep the pressure on between them. [3][4]

steps.text: With your partner, rob a first shop and keep your wanted level up. [3][4]
Rob two more shops back-to-back without the wanted level clearing. [3][6]
If the heat drops, the chain resets — start over with a fresh run. [1][3]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. There are 277 vehicles in total and the 100% checklist wants 200, so scan everything you see from the start — the counter only grows when you scan. [3][4]

steps.text: Scan each new vehicle you meet with the WAiNK app. [3][4]
Reach 100 vehicles discovered. [3][6]
Push on to 200 vehicles for the 100% checklist. [3]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a busy fight with five or more enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. [3][4]

steps.text: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together. [3][4]
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. [3][6]
If you fall short, retry in the next big fight — the count is per use. [1][3]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is not settled in the guides we read. The description points at VCIA, the airport: the working reading is to take a plane and leave the airport without a scheduled flight. We mark it unconfirmed rather than invent a step. [3][6][14]

steps.text: Go to VCIA, the airport, and look for a flyable plane. [3][6]
UNCONFIRMED: try taking off in a plane without a scheduled flight — the guides disagree on the exact trigger, so treat this as a lead, not a fact. [3][14]
If it does not pop, try another aircraft or approach at the airport and report what worked. [1][3]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is not settled in the guides we read. The name and description point at the Rhino tank: the working reading is a stunt or feat performed in a Rhino. We mark it unconfirmed rather than invent a step. [2][3][6][14]

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank in Leonida. [2][3]
UNCONFIRMED: try a driving feat in the Rhino — the guides disagree on the exact trigger, so treat this as a lead, not a fact. [3][6]
If it does not pop, try other tank feats and report what worked. [1][14]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm — take the goods and slip out clean. [3][4]

steps.text: Find a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry. [3][4]
Take the goods without being detected — avoid alarms and witnesses. [3][6]
Leave clean; if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you try again. [1][3]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Large bank vault robberies unlock through the story and automatically bring a 4-star wanted level, so plan the getaway before you go in. There are 8 vaults in total; 5 are needed here. [3][4][11]

steps.text: Unlock large bank vault robberies through the story. [3][4]
Rob a vault, then escape the 4-star wanted level it brings. [3][11]
Repeat for 5 vaults in total. [3]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops that follow. [3][4]

steps.text: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it. [3][4]
Crack the truck and take the cash. [3][6]
Escape the wanted level that follows. [1][3]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail the whole map — the counter ticks up as each named area is visited, and the map screen shows which ones are still blank. [3][4][11]

steps.text: Travel the whole map — all 52 named areas count. [3][4]
Check the map screen for areas you have not visited yet. [3][6]
Visit the last blank areas, including the far corners and islands. [3][11]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One hit per gang — find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next. [3][4][11]

steps.text: Find an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. [3][4]
Rob one operation per gang — repeats on the same gang do not count. [3][11]
Escape after each robbery; the counter tracks gangs, not robberies. [3][6]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, order a cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, no combat needed. [3][4]

steps.text: Go to Ocean Beach on the Vice City waterfront. [3][4]
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the ocean view. [3][6]
The trophy pops once the drink and the view are both had. [1][3]

steps.text: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City. [3][6]
UNCONFIRMED: try smashing a car out through the showroom glass — the guides disagree on the exact trigger, so treat this as a lead, not a fact. [3][14]

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. [3][4]

steps.text: Look for partner activities that draw a crowd. [2][3]

Reach $100,000 spent in total. [3]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages cost serious money, so this is a late-game buy — robbery cash and laundered bills fund it. Each garage also stores the vehicles you register. [3][4][11]

steps.text: Save robbery and laundering cash for property purchases. [3][4]
Buy each of the 8 garage properties as you can afford them. [3][6]
The trophy pops on the eighth garage. [3][11]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, bring them to a garage, and register them through the app — ten registrations and the trophy pops. [3][4]

steps.text: Find and collect vehicles across Leonida. [3][4]
Register each one to the Scooter Bros app. [3][6]
Reach 10 vehicles registered. [3]
